description: This file defines the Zend_Registry class, which manages a singleton registry for storing and retrieving global objects and data within the Zend Framework. It provides methods for initializing, setting, and accessing shared data, as well as configuring the class used for the registry.

classes.name: Zend_Registry
classes.description: A singleton class that provides a global storage register, allowing different parts of the application to share objects and data via key-value pairs. Extends ArrayObject to allow object-like and array-like access.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the default singleton registry instance, initializing it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: setInstance
methods.description: Sets the singleton registry instance to a specific Zend_Registry object, throws exception if already initialized.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the registry singleton with the class specified in $_registryClassName.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the class name used for creating the registry instance, with checks for validity and class existence.

methods.name: _unsetInstance
methods.description: Unsets the singleton instance, used mainly for testing purposes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with a specific key in the registry, throws an exception if the key is not registered.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the registry under the specified key.

methods.name: isRegistered
methods.description: Checks if a specific key is registered in the registry.
